india_trends.title: Axiscades Technologies rises 5% as Sunil Singhania's Abakkus buys 3.03% stake
india_trends.summary: Axiscades Technologies shares rose on Wednesday after Abakkus Asset Manager bought a 3.03% stake for around Rs 235 crore through a block deal. Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund also picked up a 4.89% stake. Promoter Jupiter Capital sold a 10.69% stake for Rs 829.72 crore in the transaction.

india_trends.title: Tata Sons merger proposal faces questions from Tata Trusts trustees: Report
india_trends.summary: Trustees of Tata Trusts are questioning a proposed merger involving Tata Sons that could prevent a public listing. They claim no board resolution has approved the merger, and the Sir Ratan Tata Trust is barred from meetings by the Charity Commissioner amid regulatory concerns.
